notes.title: Hotfix RELEASED - V0.1.7925
notes.content:
[p]This update fixes up some minor issues in act 1. [/p][h2]New Features: [/h2][list][*][p] Toothpick now changes colors based on its upgrades.[/p][/*][*][p] Added nearly 20 hats to the hero customization[/p][/*][*][p] Added experimental support for the Vulkan render API.
Use this by adding `-vulkan` to the launch parameters.
Performance might be better than DX12 on certain hardware.
[/p][/*][/list][h2]Quality of Life: [/h2][list][*][p] Made low health heartbeat way more subtle[/p][/*][/list][h2]Fixes:[/h2][list][*][p] Fixed some soft-locks when you're missing certain abilities.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed some missing percentages. You can now 100% on fresh saves again.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed missing solver's page after loading.[/p][/*][*][p] Ensured RGB mural is never blurry.[/p][/*][*][p] Bunch of small fixes.
[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Toothpick now changes colors based on its upgrades.
Added nearly 20 hats to the hero customization

Added experimental support for the Vulkan render API.
Use this by adding `-vulkan` to the launch parameters.
Performance might be better than DX12 on certain hardware.

tags.bug: Fixed some soft-locks when you're missing certain abilities.
Fixed some missing percentages. You can now 100% on fresh saves again.
Fixed missing solver's page after loading.
Ensured RGB mural is never blurry.

notes.title: Update 2 - V0.1.7708
notes.content:
[h2]New Features:[/h2][list][*][p] Added new mysteries and a puzzle sequence in previously underwhelming sections including 8 knowledge gates (if you have an old save: start in the house of the nerd with the spikey front yard) - this adds another mandatory step in the middle of the "imperial helmet" quest.[/p][/*][*][p] Added two new puzzles behind Floortown.[/p][/*][*][p] Added a 2nd legal way to get the sponge suit. [/p][/*][*][p] Added secret trick to get toothpin for free [/p][/*][*][p] Reworked and added some secrets.[/p][/*][*][p] 3 New achievements for you to get!
[/p][/*][/list][h2]Quality of life:[/h2][list][*][p] Carriables now leave a hologram behind at their spawn location.[/p][/*][*][p] Made Ghost more transparent and quiet. [/p][/*][*][p] Rebalanced presents and coins (less presents in too easy to reach sections).[/p][/*][*][p] Snail area and castle vicinity now have separate secret counters.[/p][/*][*][p] A few Secret area changes and additions.[/p][/*][*][p] Less enemy spawns.[/p][/*][*][p] Toothpick has more stabbing range.[/p][/*][*][p] Floppy disk puzzle also works in a non- meta way now.[/p][/*][*][p] Added more puzzle police.[/p][/*][*][p] Made less carriables lose their initial spawn location when fashionized.[/p][/*][*][p] Solver guide's hints are numbered now.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Fixes:[/h2][list][*][p] Finetuned the start to ease in players a little bit better.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed bug where game would not save anymore after a combat arena.[/p][/*][*][p] Prevented some paths that skip a lot at the castle.[/p][/*][*][p] Suitcase turned around 180° for OOB reasons.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed way of getting "jump height x2" egg without solving the puzzle.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed potato near acid not working right.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed magnet not working on objects that were respawned while being magnetized.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed various OOBs.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed bug where Padlock guy didn't remember his combination.[/p][/*][*][p] Made sure certain textures that need to be readable never become blurry when vram is too full (that also made safety glass look breakable which it wasn't).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Misc:[/h2][list][*][p] Lots of little or big improvements here or there to make puzzles fairer and better to use.[/p][/*][*][p] Various small performance fixes.[/p][/*][*][p] Upgraded engine to 5.6.1.[/p][/*][*][p] Disabled XeSS due to issues with Unreal 5.6.1.[/p][/*][/list]

[p] Added two new puzzles behind Floortown.[/p]

notes.title: Update V0.1.7448
notes.content:
[b]Update V0.1.7448[/b]

-Less enemy spawns
-Dark places are brighter, blinding things are darker
-Made many puzzles more fair based on what players reported and what we saw in streams
-FSR frame generation now actually works (was broken before)
-XeSS fixed
-Added new puzzle behind fashion store in town (helps tutorialize fashion store better)
-Jump now jumps less if you only tap jump button slightly (hold for max height)
-Fixed wrong playtime in save slots (does not fully fix old save game times)
-More puzzle police added (you players are outrageous!)
-Added new NPC reactions based on watching people play
-Fixed "High"-achievement fake solution with gears and propeller
-Fixed critical bug with "gasmask guy puzzle" under bed
-Many other fixes and improvements everywhere to make things fairer and more enjoyable

Thanks for the big support! The countless feedback helps a lot!
